text:
Alex: Quick sweep results for mixtral-7B-MoE router sensitivity + kernel selection. Ran 3 configs across 4 nodes. TL;DR: router topk=4 -> 12% tail latency increase under KV fill pressure; topk=1 -> better load but small quality reg in eval set. Details below.

Maya: Nice. Which kernels did you use for softmax + topk? cuBLAS? our custom softfill?

Alex: We compared kernel_set A (default: mix_kernels_v2) vs B (experimental: softfill-fast + rope-rot-dense). Kernel B reduced softmax time by ~30ms p50 but increased memory traffic -> KV eviction up 18%.

Jorge: Profiling dump:
```
[perf] route_stage: cpu 12% | gpu kernel softfill_fast: 18ms | topk_gpu: 9ms | kv_lookup: 22ms (hot)
nvprof: dram_read=12.3GB/s dram_write=4.9GB/s
router_logits_peak: 512 entries
expert_queue_len: avg 34
```

Maya: That kv_lookup 22ms is the killer. Is it due to cache misses from many different prefixes or our per-expert locking? Any traces of lock contention?

Alex: Lock contention showed up for expert cache when parallelism >= 8. With expert_parallelism=4, we keep per-expert queues small -> kv hit rate +7%. Experiment logs: https://redwood-infra/runs/1861002345

PerfBot: auto-summary: config sweep 2026-03-16: best tail latency p99=210ms (topk=1, kernel=B, expert_parallelism=4). cost_score normalized=1.12 vs baseline 1.0. regression_alert=false :white_check_mark:

Sophie: Suggestion: try hybrid batching heuristic: max_batch = min(128, 512/(median_seq_len+16)) and enable prefix_cache for frequent prefixes. Also lower router temperature from 1.0 -> 0.7 to tighten logits and reduce multi-expert fanout.

Maya: Can we simulate effect on eval set quality (bleu/emd)? Topk=1 had a small drop on "multi-hop" prompts.

Alex: Yeah small drop: qa-f1 -1.8%, instruct-quality degraded on few narrow prompts. Tradeoff seems acceptable for latency-sensitive customers.

Jorge: Kernel selection note: softfill-fast uses faster warp-level reductions but requires larger shared memory; on A100s it's fine, on T4s it regresses. We should gate kernel B by hardware tag.

Sophie: We should add a smart-router policy: if kv_eviction_rate > 10% then fall back to topk=1 or enable local-cache-mode. Pseudoconfig:
```
router_policy:
  fallback_on_kv_eviction: true
  eviction_threshold_pct: 10
  fallback_topk: 1
```

Alex: Next steps: 1) add hw-gate for kernel B, 2) test hybrid batching across seq_len percentiles, 3) run longer eval for quality. I'll open an RFC.

Maya: Ack, please pin the perf traces here when ready.

Jorge: added flamegraphs + nvprof to the run link.

PerfBot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled for mixtral-moerouter v0.9.3 at 2026-03-17 04:00 UTC. :rocket:

Sophie: Nice. minor: also consider lowering per-request kv_timeout to 12ms to avoid stalls.

Alex: Good call. I'll include that in the RFC.
